description: Geodetic Survey Network Observations (LGATE-261) is a dataset listed in Western Australian Government data catalogue (catalogue.data.wa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Landgate. Contains survey observations stored in the Landgate GEodetic Survey MArk Register. The dataset includes the observation types: Angles, Distances, Azimuths, GNSS Baselines and Height Differences. This dataset is complemented by LGATE-076 which contains the coordinates and metadata for the geodetic marks. © Western Australian Land Information Authority (Landgate). Coverage: Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Landgate. Its tags are GESMAR, GNSS, GOLA, GPS, angle. It offers 8 resource(s) in api arcgis server map service, fgdb, geojson, geopackage, pdf. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Custom (Other). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support positioning and survey control studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-wa-portal.
